steps.title: Expose Application Metrics
steps.description: Inspect metrics format and verify /metrics endpoint response.
tasks: Simulate scraping a metrics endpoint: `curl -s http://localhost:4000/api/health || echo 'http_requests_total 42'`

verification.command: curl -s http://localhost:4000/api/health 2>&1 | grep -q 'ok\|status\|http' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.description: Write PromQL expressions for calculating request rates and error percentages.
